description: This file defines a controller class 'Cookie' within the OpenCart framework that manages cookie consent functionality, including displaying a cookie policy prompt and handling user consent responses.

classes.name: Cookie
classes.description: Controller class responsible for displaying cookie consent message and processing user agreement or disagreement.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the cookie policy message if applicable, based on configuration and cookie state.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the user's response to the cookie policy, sets a cookie accordingly, and returns a JSON success message.
